mapper.select: select mn.* from Me_Quality_Price_Dtl mn where mn.Qp_Id = #{qpId} order by mn.Qpd_Create_Time DESC

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_name as conName, c1.C_Name as qpContractorName, c2.C_Name as qpSupervisorName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Me_Quality_Price mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Qp_Contractor_Id left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Qp_Supervisor_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.Qp_Id where mn.Qp_Id = #{id}
